title: Leveraging Segmentation Representations for Efficient Classification: A Self-Configuring Framework Based on nnU-Net
abstract: arXiv:2611.22380v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose a self-configuring framework that extends the nnU-Net workflow to both segmentation and classification in 3D medical imaging. Building on nnU-Net's self-configuring method, the framework reuses representations learned by a segmentation model for image-level classification. Its encoder features and predicted segmentation probabilities are used by a lightweight classifier. Two information-sharing strategies are investigated. In the frozen-backbone branch, features are augmented with region-of-interest information, predicted foreground volume, and segmentation confidence. In the adaptation branch, the final encoder stage is partially fine-tuned for classification, with an auxiliary segmentation loss to preserve segmentation-related information. Additional five-fold experiments showed that more complex configurations did not consistently improve classification performance. On the public validation leaderboard, our selected frame

translated_title: 利用分割表示实现高效分类：一种基于nnU-Net的自配置框架
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一个自配置框架，将nnU-Net工作流程扩展到3D医学影像中的分割和分类两种任务。基于nnU-Net的自配置方法，该框架复用分割模型学习到的表示来实现图像级分类。其编码器特征和预测的分割概率被一个轻量级分类器所利用。论文研究了两种信息共享策略：在冻结主干分支中，特征通过与感兴趣区域信息、预测前景体积和分割置信度相结合来增强；在适应分支中，最后的编码器阶段针对分类任务进行部分微调，并通过辅助分割损失来保留与分割相关的信息。额外的五折实验表明，更复杂的配置并不能持续提升分类性能。在公开的验证排行榜上，我们选定的框架……
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于nnU-Net的自配置框架，通过复用分割模型学习到的编码器特征和分割概率，结合轻量级分类器与两种信息共享策略，高效实现3D医学影像的图像级分类。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a self-configuring framework based on nnU-Net that efficiently performs image-level classification in 3D medical imaging by reusing encoder features and predicted segmentation probabilities from a segmentation model with a lightweight classifier.
